gate_definition: Previous realized trace / preceding22-session mean trace; beta=clip(log(ratio/lower)/log(3/lower),0,1); all inputs strictly lagged
selectors: 252 genuinely past outcomes, same3 integrated/return/combined minimax criteria, HAR-DRD fallback
iteration_rule: Primary and all variants fixed before stress-family evaluation; retain every failure and report outcome-selected models separately
evaluation: Same245 development and397 reused later dates
qualification: Retrospective exploratory extension, not independent confirmation or original GHAR numerical reproduction
